<noinclude>
This is the "Equipment" form.

To create a page with this form, enter the page name below;
if a page with that name already exists, you will be sent to a form to edit that page.

{{#forminput:form=Equipment|autocomplete on category=Equipment}}
</noinclude>
<includeonly>
<div id="wikiPreview" style="display: none; padding-bottom: 25px; margin-bottom: 25px; border-bottom: 1px solid #AAAAAA;"></div>

{{{for template|Equipment}}}

{| class="formtable"
|-
! Equipment Name:
| {{{field|name|mandatory|input type=text|size=50}}}
|-
! Equipment Type:
| {{{field|type|mandatory|input type=dropdown|values=Microscope,Centrifuge,Incubator,Autoclave,Spectrophotometer,Other}}}
|-
! Manufacturer:
| {{{field|manufacturer|input type=text|size=50}}}
|-
! Model:
| {{{field|model|input type=text|size=50}}}
|-
! Serial Number:
| {{{field|serial_number|input type=text|size=50}}}
|-
! Location:
| {{{field|location|mandatory|input type=combobox|values from category=Lab Room|autocomplete on property=Room Number}}}
|-
! Status:
| {{{field|status|mandatory|input type=dropdown|values=Active,Inactive,Archived|default=Active}}}
|-
! Owner:
| {{{field|owner|input type=combobox|values from category=Personnel|autocomplete on property=Personnel Role}}}
|-
! Purchase Date:
| {{{field|purchase_date|mandatory|input type=date}}}
|-
! Cost ($):
| {{{field|cost|input type=number|size=20}}}
|-
! Last Maintenance Date:
| {{{field|last_maintenance|input type=date}}}
|-
! Next Calibration Date:
| {{{field|next_calibration|input type=date}}}
|}

{{{end template}}}

'''Free text:'''

{{{standard input|free text|rows=10}}}
</includeonly>
